# Iron Prairie Fabrication Group LLC

> Certified woman-owned metal fabrication shop in Bay City, Texas (200 County Rd 170) delivering ASME B16.48 paddle blinds, CNC plasma cutting, structural steel, ranch gates, tornado shelters, and nationwide shipping across all 50 states.

## Services & Solutions
- [ASME B16.48 Paddle Blinds](https://ironprairiefabrication.com/paddle-blinds): Positive isolation paddle blinds and spacer rings with certified MTRs and daily nationwide shipping.
- [CNC Plasma & Welding](https://ironprairiefabrication.com/services): High-definition plasma plate cutting, practical welding, and custom steel assemblies for industrial and ranch use.
- [Ranch Gates & Agriculture](https://ironprairiefabrication.com/services): Custom hog and livestock pens, farm equipment, ranch gates, and fence-line steel fabrication.
- [Public Agency Fabrication](https://ironprairiefabrication.com/woman-owned): SAM.gov registered (UEI XX7XCMGN9XD5) fabricator for TPWD, National Parks, municipal, and federal scopes.
- [Secure Specialty Builds](https://ironprairiefabrication.com/services): Custom bunkers, tornado shelter steelwork, and large built-in safes.
- [B2B Storefront](https://ironprairiefabrication.com/storefront): Instant paddle blind configurator with pricing, weight, MTR packets, and Stripe checkout.
